summary.platform: WordPress + Yoast SEO + AAWP + Elementor (Astra theme) on Hostinger
summary.scope: 285 posts, 20 pages, 58 categories, 310 tags, 1 author; homepage + ~40 URLs sampled across templates
top_findings: 310 indexable tag archives (87% keyword-stuffed, ~1 post each) — severe index bloat / Helpful-Content risk
No first-hand testing evidence: roundups recycle Amazon listing copy as 'reviews' (E-E-A-T Experience near zero)
~20 duplicate '-2' posts + 4 competing 'XLR vs USB' URLs (one titled 'for Crime Writers') — cannibalization + AI-content signal
Empty WebSite.name + no Organization schema + no Review/Product/ItemList on 285 affiliate posts
Poor performance: hotlinked Unsplash LCP, HTML uncacheable at CDN (AAWP cookie), render-blocking jQuery/fonts
quick_wins: Set WordPress Site Title = 'Audio Tech Expert' (fixes empty WebSite.name + dangling ' - ' titles in one change)
Yoast: noindex tag archives & drop post_tag sitemap (clears ~46% of index bloat in 1 toggle)
Yoast: enable Organization knowledge-graph with logo
Add HSTS + X-Content-Type-Options + X-Frame-Options + Referrer-Policy via .htaccess; disable wp-json user enumeration & block xmlrpc.php

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS sitewide; clean 301s for http→https, www→non-www, trailing-slash; proper 404s
Self-referential canonicals on posts; valid robots.txt + Yoast sitemap index; HTTP/2+HTTP/3
Server-rendered (no SPA); correct viewport; generous index,follow,max-image-preview:large

findings.title: 310 tag archives indexed with near-zero content
findings.description: post_tag-sitemap has 310 indexable tags (>285 posts); 87% are keyword-stuffed slugs (e.g. tag/acoustic-guitar-microphone-...-shure-sm57-...) rendering only chrome, ~1 post each.
findings.recommendation: Yoast → Search Appearance → Taxonomies → Tags → 'Show in search results' = No (noindex + removes from sitemap).

findings.title: ~20 live '-2' duplicate posts, both self-canonical
findings.description: WordPress auto-slug collisions (-2…-7) create duplicate posts competing for the same intent; the clean /best-noise-cancelling-headphones/ even 301s to the ugly -2026-2 slug.
findings.recommendation: Audit each pair; 301 the weaker to the stronger; ensure survivor self-canonicals; fix internal links.

findings.title: Duplicate /guides/recording-production/ vs /recording-production/
findings.description: Both 200, identical titles/H1, self-canonical, both in sitemap.
findings.recommendation: 301 /recording-production/ → /guides/recording-production/; remove from sitemap.

findings.title: /headphone-guides-old/ legacy page indexed
findings.description: 200, index,follow, in sitemap, H1 'Headphone Guides Old', thin body.
findings.recommendation: 301 → /headphone-guides/ (or noindex) and remove from sitemap.

findings.title: Missing security headers + stack exposure
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy; x-powered-by PHP/8.3.30; wp-json/wp/v2/users exposes login slug 'peter_froggatt'; xmlrpc.php reachable (405).
findings.recommendation: .htaccess security headers; expose_php Off; disable REST user endpoint; block xmlrpc.php.

findings.title: Render-blocking resources / CWV lab risk
findings.description: jQuery+Migrate sync in <head>; 16 blocking CSS; 19 scripts without async/defer; no LCP fetchpriority; 12/15 images without dimensions.
findings.recommendation: Defer non-critical JS, enable Elementor/critical-CSS optimization, set image dimensions, fetchpriority on LCP.

findings.title: Homepage has two H1 (one is 'Home')
findings.description:
Theme entry-title

Home

plus hero

Audio Gear, Tested and Explained

.
findings.recommendation: Suppress the templated title H1; keep one descriptive H1.

findings.title: IndexNow not enabled; author archive indexed
findings.description: /indexnow 404; /author/peter_froggatt/ indexed (login-slug exposure + thin duplicate listing).
findings.recommendation: Enable Yoast IndexNow; noindex author archive and/or change public author slug.

findings.title: x-robots-tag: noindex on non-HTML only
findings.description: noindex header appears solely on robots.txt/XML/xmlrpc (text-plain/xml), never on HTML pages. Harmless Hostinger behaviour.
findings.recommendation: No action.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Transparent /how-we-choose/ methodology (~964 words); named author; readable FK grade 9–11
Roundups assign each pick a role and name a real limitation

findings.title: No hands-on testing evidence in affiliate roundups
findings.description: Methodology admits no physical testing; picks justified by Amazon/manufacturer copy (e.g. WH-1000XM6 'based on everything its title tells us'). Google reviews system targets exactly this.
findings.recommendation: Add original photos + concrete per-pick impressions to top 5–10 roundups, or reframe as 'curated research roundups'.

findings.title: No author photo; incomplete Person; credential mismatch
findings.description: About page has no author photo (alt placeholder 'The person behind the reviews'); posts claim '15 years building signal chains' while About describes a crime novelist.
findings.recommendation: Add real author photo + full Person schema (image, sameAs→phillipstrang.com); reconcile audio credentials on About.

findings.title: Stock/AI imagery, no original product photography
findings.description: Homepage hotlinks Unsplash; a review hero filename '48arKdwIqXYlgqCAspDgB.jpg' looks AI-generated; product images are Amazon CDN thumbnails.
findings.recommendation: Photograph real units; if AI retained, add IPTC DigitalSourceType; self-host hero.

findings.title: 'Reviews' framing vs research-only methodology
findings.description: Brand/URLs say 'reviews'/'best' but no testing occurs — QRG/FTC alignment risk and reviews-system demotion risk.
findings.recommendation: Soften to 'guides/recommendations'; add original analysis beyond the Amazon listing per roundup.

findings.title: Thin content / index bloat (310 tags, 58 categories)
findings.description: More tag archives than posts; categories average <5 posts.
findings.recommendation: Noindex tags; merge/noindex sub-4-post categories.

findings.title: Thin Contact (~88 words) and shallow About (391 words)
findings.description: Contact may be a form shortcode stripped from raw HTML — verify; About leads with fiction career, no audio depth.
findings.recommendation: Confirm contact form renders + add fallback; expand About to 600–800 words with audio credibility.

findings.title: No external citations / Review-ItemList schema / update dates on explainers
findings.description: No outbound authority links; AAWP boxes emit no JSON-LD; explainers lack visible 'last updated'.
findings.recommendation: Add 1–2 authority links/post; ItemList/Review schema; review-date stamps.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Meta descriptions present and well-sized (133–159 chars) on every page sampled
Review/guide posts: single H1, descriptive 49–60 char titles, 1,300–1,600 words, self-canonical
Clean readable slugs; modern robots meta

findings.title: Empty WP Site Title breaks brand titles
findings.description: Category/landing titles dangle with ' - ' and no brand: 'Guides -' (8 chars), 'Contact -' (9), 'Headphone Comparisons -' (23). Same root cause as empty WebSite.name.
findings.recommendation: Set WP Site Title = 'Audio Tech Expert'; define Yoast title templates for pages/archives.

findings.title: Duplicate title + duplicate page (recording-production)
findings.description: /recording-production/ and /guides/recording-production/ share identical title and overlapping content.
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize to one URL; 301 the other.

findings.title: Legacy /headphone-guides-old/ indexable
findings.description: 200, index,follow, duplicates /headphone-guides/.
findings.recommendation: 301 or noindex; remove from sitemap.

findings.title: Multiple H1 on landing/archive templates
findings.description: Homepage, best-headphones, best-microphones, guides, about-us, recording-production each render 2 H1.
findings.recommendation: One H1 per template.

findings.title: Thin/auto-generated category titles + missing alt text
findings.description: Archive titles carry no keyword value; ~3 imgs/page lack alt (theme/affiliate images).
findings.recommendation: Write descriptive titles; add alt text.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Yoast emits structurally valid JSON-LD (correct @context/@id/ISO dates) on every page
Posts carry Article + BreadcrumbList + Person + ImageObject (site-hosted, with dimensions)

findings.title: WebSite.name (and description) empty sitewide
findings.description: name:'' on all pages — no brand label for sitelinks search box / AI attribution.
findings.recommendation: Set site name in Yoast/WordPress (5-min fix).

findings.title: No Organization schema anywhere
findings.description: No Organization node (Astra microdata Org has empty name/url). Publisher entity absent for E-E-A-T + AI.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization via Yoast knowledge graph with logo + publishingPrinciples → /how-we-choose/.

findings.title: No Review/Product/ItemList on 285 affiliate posts
findings.description: AAWP stores ASIN/price but emits no schema; no product rich-result eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList→Product→Offer (affiliate-tagged) on roundups, auto-built from AAWP via wpseo_schema_graph_pieces.

findings.title: Person schema incomplete; absent on /about-us/
findings.description: Person.sameAs only lists own homepage; no worksFor/knowsAbout; About page has no Person.
findings.recommendation: Enrich Person (sameAs→phillipstrang.com, worksFor→Organization, knowsAbout, hosted photo).

findings.title: Misc: keywords string-in-array, missing dateModified, Unsplash ImageObject
findings.description: Article.keywords is one comma-joined string; one post missing dateModified; homepage/category primaryImage hotlinks Unsplash.
findings.recommendation: Array of keyword strings; ensure dateModified; self-host ImageObject.

findings.title: FAQ sections present but no FAQPage schema
findings.description: Posts have Q&A blocks; FAQ rich results retired May 2026 (no SERP gain) but markup aids AI citation.
findings.recommendation: Optional FAQPage for GEO.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Speculation Rules prefetch present; logo has explicit dimensions; HTTP/2+3
GTM async; Site Kit & Mailchimp deferred

findings.title: LCP hero hotlinked from images.unsplash.com (est. 4.5–6s, Poor)
findings.description: Third-party LCP image, no fetchpriority/preload, CSS-background hero invisible to preload scanner.
findings.recommendation: Self-host + WebP, fetchpriority=high + preload, set width/height.

findings.title: HTML uncacheable at CDN (DYNAMIC, TTFB 387–531ms)
findings.description: AAWP sets aawp-country cookie on every response → Hostinger CDN bypasses cache → full PHP render per visit.
findings.recommendation: Strip/ignore the AAWP cookie at CDN/cache layer or set country client-side; target HIT/~50ms.

findings.title: Render-blocking jQuery + 5 Google Fonts (no preconnect)
findings.description: jQuery+Migrate sync in <head>; 5 font CSS across 2 origins; only dns-prefetch for GTM.
findings.recommendation: Defer jQuery; self-host/dedupe fonts; add preconnects.

findings.title: CLS: 11 Unsplash images without width/height; images JPEG not WebP
findings.description: No dimensions/aspect-ratio; review images JPEG; below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.recommendation: Set dimensions; WebP/AVIF; lazy-load below-fold.

findings.title: 13+ synchronous Elementor JS at body end (INP est. 250–350ms)
findings.description: Elementor Pro runtime + smartmenus + EAEL compete with interaction handlers.
findings.recommendation: Enable Elementor Improved Asset Loading; consider non-Elementor homepage.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: All AI crawlers allowed (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Bingbot)
Strong product-entity anchors (Shure SM7B, Blue Yeti, Neumann TLM 103) and inline specs

findings.title: Empty WebSite.name blocks AI attribution
findings.description: AI engines pull publisher name from WebSite.name; empty = site can't be named as a source.
findings.recommendation: Set site name (single highest-impact GEO fix).

findings.title: No comparison tables on comparison content
findings.description: Zero <table> on sampled vs/best pages; AI Overviews/Perplexity favour tabular comparisons.
findings.recommendation: Add spec/feature comparison tables to all vs/best posts.

findings.title: No llms.txt; no Quick-Answer/TL;DR blocks
findings.description: /llms.txt 404; paragraphs 40–78 words (below citation range); no self-contained answer blocks.
findings.recommendation: Publish llms.txt (top 25–30 guides); add 80–150 word answer block under each H1.

findings.title: Weak entity/authority graph
findings.description: No Organization/sameAs; no Wikipedia/Wikidata; no YouTube (strongest AI-citation correlation).
findings.recommendation: Add Organization+sameAs; build YouTube/entity presence; fix copy-paste intro artifact.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Logo has explicit dimensions; post featured images are self-hosted with caption

findings.title: Hotlinked Unsplash stock as primary/hero imagery
findings.description: Homepage + category primaryImage and 11 homepage imgs hotlink images.unsplash.com (LCP risk, no cache control, ToS risk, not original).
findings.recommendation: Self-host original/branded images.

findings.title: No next-gen formats; missing dimensions; thin alt
findings.description: Review images JPEG (no WebP/AVIF); 12/15 homepage imgs lack width/height (CLS); ~3 imgs/page lack alt.
findings.recommendation: WebP/AVIF pipeline; explicit dimensions; descriptive alt on product/affiliate images.

findings.title: Likely AI-generated hero images unlabeled
findings.description: Hash-like filenames suggest AI generation; no IPTC DigitalSourceType.
findings.recommendation: Add IPTC AI labels (scripts/iptc_ai_label.py) or replace with real photos.

supplementary.sxo_summary: Systematic page-type mismatch: 'how-to-choose' guides aimed at 'best X' listicle SERPs; 4 competing XLR-vs-USB URLs (one 'for Crime Writers'); hub pages are prose directories; zero comparison tables; affiliate CTAs missing on guide/comparison pages.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Set WP Site Title = 'Audio Tech Expert' (fixes empty WebSite.name + dangling category titles).
Yoast: noindex tag archives + remove post_tag sitemap (clears ~310 thin URLs / 46% of index).
Add HSTS + X-Content-Type-Options + X-Frame-Options + Referrer-Policy; expose_php Off; disable wp-json user enumeration; block xmlrpc.php.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Audit & 301 the ~20 '-2' duplicate posts; move best-noise-cancelling page to a clean slug.
Add Organization schema + enrich Person (sameAs→phillipstrang.com, worksFor, knowsAbout, photo).
Performance: self-host+WebP all images with dimensions; fix AAWP-cookie CDN caching; defer jQuery; self-host/dedupe fonts; fetchpriority/preload LCP.
Consolidate XLR-vs-USB to one general-audience canonical; redirect crime-writer + duplicate variants.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add first-hand evidence (photos + impressions) to top 10 roundups, or reframe as research roundups; reconcile author credentials + add author photo.
Convert /best-headphones/ & /best-microphones/ into conversion listicle hubs; add comparison tables + above-the-fold 'Top Picks' + methodology to all roundups.
Split 'how-to-choose' guides from true 'best X' listicles; add affiliate CTAs to guides/comparisons.
Add ItemList+Product schema to roundups; publish llms.txt; add Quick-Answer blocks + comparison tables for GEO.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console + GA4; re-run this audit with field data (CrUX) and indexation/coverage.
Capture an SEO drift baseline (scripts/drift_baseline.py) and compare after each deploy.
Quarterly review-date refresh on explainers; track index count drop after tag noindex; monitor rankings for consolidated URLs.
